idea-plugin.name: SSRF via Unsanitized URL Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on an HTTP call (HttpRequest.newBuilder(...)/ Spring RestTemplate/OkHttp's Request.Builder) whose URL/host argument traces back (within the same method, one direct hop) to an untrusted Spring MVC/JAX-RS controller parameter, with no allowlist validation found in the same method -- CWE-918, Server-Side Request Forgery. An attacker uses the server itself as a proxy toward internal resources (cloud metadata endpoints, internal services with no perimeter authentication).

Same source-to-sink flow-following mechanism as unsafe-deserialization-sink-companion (this catalog), applied to a different sink category. This exact category has a dedicated CodeQL query and a dedicated AWS CodeGuru Detector Library detector; no Marketplace plugin found doing it as an inline IDE inspection.

Stated honestly: v0.1 uses the same one-method-of-distance bound as its sibling plugin, a closed list of known HTTP sinks (java.net.http.HttpClient, RestTemplate, OkHttp), no general taint analysis of the whole project.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
